'''Blue Flight''' was the designation of two successive [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] units serving aboard the cruiser [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].

At the [[Battle of Doornik-319]], the Blue Flight designation was used by a formation of [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighters]] from the [[16th Fighter Squadron]], commanded by [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]], and tasked to provide cover for the six [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]s of the [[24th Bombardment Squadron]]'s [[Red Flight (K-wings)|Red Flight]].

After the debacle at Doornik-319, the starfighter forces aboard ''Indomitable'' were reorganised. At the subsequent [[Battle of ILC-905]], the Blue Flight designation was used by a formation consisting of three K-wings from the restructured 24th Bombardment Squadron, and their strengthened [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] escort of six [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]. The E-wings which provided cover for the downsized Red Flight now used callsigns such as [[Cover Four]] and [[Cover Eight]].

During this engagement, the new Blue Flight was tasked to attack the [[Black Nine]] shipyard, a mission in which they sustained heavy losses without achieving any tangible result. [[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]] was destroyed by flak from the defending [[Aramadia-class thrustship|''Aramadia''-class thrustships]], while [[Blue Two/Legends|Blue Two]] was intercepted by a [[D-type fighter|Yevethan fighter]] during the attack run. [[Blue One/Legends|Blue One]] was the only K-wing from the unit to successfully complete an attack, launching a [[T-33 plasma torpedo]], but this impacted harmlessly on the spacedock's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. As well as the two downed K-wings, at least half of the flight's escorting X-wings were also destroyed in the engagement.

The shipyard was subsequently destroyed by their counterparts from Red Flight.

==Behind the scenes==
The novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'' identifies Blue Flight as a unit of E-wings escorting the K-wings of Red Flight, and after describing the destruction of three of Red Flight's K-wings, adds the statement, "Blue Flight fared even worse&mdash;only one of the bombers made it back to the comparative safety of ''Indomitable''{{'s}} hangar bays." As no bomber unit called Blue Flight is mentioned previously in the novel, this sentence appears to mean that least four E-wings from Red Flight's escort unit were destroyed, and as a result, two more of the K-wings were also claimed by the Yevethan fighters, with only [[Red One]] returning to the cruiser.
